 Medvedev vs Tiafoe Prediction, Picks & H2H History (Nov 20)
 By 
 Juan Pablo Aravena
 in
 Tennis
 Published:
 November 20, 2026 at 8:44 am EST
 Tennis - U.S. Open - Flushing Meadows, New York, United States - September 6, 2026 Russia's Daniil Medvedev in action during his round of 16 match against Frances Tiafoe of the U.S. IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters/Jerry Lai 
 Medvedev’s stronger Elo profile and 6-3 record in the listed meetings make him the more defensible moneyline side
 Tiafoe’s tiebreak record and recent US Open win keep the American live to push this close in Medvedev vs Tiafoe prediction 
 Expect a competitive baseline battle, with the Over 22.5 games (-127) still in play in Medvedev vs Tiafoe picks 
 The stakes are massive in the Ivan Lendl Group of the ATP Finals as world No. 5 Daniil Medvedev clashes with No. 8 Frances Tiafoe with a spot in the semifinals on the line. First serve is scheduled for 2:30 PM ET, November 20, at the Inalpi Arena in Turin.
 Medvedev enters as the favorite, and the underlying numbers support that position more strongly than the narrow head-to-head narrative might suggest. Tiafoe has shown he can trouble Medvedev, but the overall matchup data points to the Russian as the likelier winner.
 Medvedev vs Tiafoe H2H Results
 Date Tournament Winner Score 
 2026-09-06 US Open Tiafoe 7-6, 6-4, 7-6 
 2026-01-06 Brisbane Medvedev 6-3, 6-2 
 2024-09-21 Laver Cup Tiafoe 3-6, 6-4, 10-5 
 2023-03-18 Indian Wells Medvedev 7-5, 7-6 
 2021-03-30 Miami Medvedev 6-4, 6-3 
 2020-09-07 US Open Medvedev 6-4, 6-1, 6-0 
 2020-01-21 Australian Open Medvedev 6-3, 4-6, 6-4, 6-2 
 2019-08-01 Washington Medvedev 6-2, 7-5 
 2015-05-16 Nice qualifying Tiafoe 6-3, 6-2 
 The full H2H history gives Medvedev six wins to Tiafoe’s three, although Tiafoe won their most recent meeting in a three-set US Open rout. That result shows the American can extend the contest, but it does not erase Medvedev’s broader advantage in the rivalry.
 Tiafoe vs Medvedev Picks & Prediction
 The matchup metrics point toward Medvedev on the moneyline, while Tiafoe’s recent form and tiebreak strength offer a reason to expect resistance and an elevated game count.
 Moneyline Prediction: Medvedev (-223 / 69¢, KALSHI) – Claim SBD’s exclusive KALSHI PROMO CODE 
 I’m taking Daniil Medvedev to win, though the -223 price leaves little room for error. Tennis Abstract’s latest Elo ratings put Medvedev at 1,989.4 and Tiafoe at 1,925.2, while Tennis Ratio’s 52-week comparison shows Medvedev ahead in dominance ratio (1.537 to 1.132), return games won (27.5% to 21.5%) and first-serve return points (33.2% to 26.0%). 
 Those advantages, together with Medvedev’s six wins in the nine listed meetings, outweigh Tiafoe’s edge in tiebreaks won (50% to 37.9%) and break-point conversion (43.3% to 41.3%).
 Tiafoe did beat Medvedev at the US Open in September, winning both tiebreaks, and his 2026 season includes several hard-court wins. Still, Medvedev won their Brisbane meeting in straight sets and has the more convincing serve-and-return profile over the past 52 weeks.
 I see the Russian as the likelier winner, but this is a lean rather than a value play at the current price.
 Total-Games Pick: Over 22.5 (-127 / 56¢, KALSHI)
 I am backing Over 22.5 total games at -127. Their most recent meeting reached 35 games, and Tiafoe’s tiebreak ability gives the total a route to the Over even if Medvedev comes through. Bettors looking to construct an SGP should consider this a more volatile leg than the match-winner pick.
 Their previous major clash required two grueling tiebreaks, demonstrating elite service holds paired with extended baseline rallies. Medvedev fired 14 aces in New York and nine in Brisbane, metrics that typically yield rapid service holds. When Medvedev’s ace rate collides with a dialed-in returner like Tiafoe, extended sets become the mathematical norm. A closely contested two-set match featuring a single tiebreak securely cleared this line historically.
